strings: Terms of Service
Terms covering the conditions for using Juple, the minimum sign-up age of 14, content and sharing, free use and account deletion.
These Terms describe the conditions for using the Juple app and the web pages for shared links. By using the service, you are deemed to accept these Terms.
1. The service

Juple is a service for quickly saving links, reviewing them in today’s saves and your full history, organizing them into collections, and sharing and collaborating with others. Purchase records and repeat-purchase management are optional features for users who need them.
2. Accounts
An account is created with an email address and password (sign-in takes place through Microsoft Entra External ID), and you are responsible for the security of your email account and password.
Only people aged 14 or older may sign up for and use Juple. You must confirm that you are 14 or older when you sign up and agree to these Terms; people under 14 may not use the service.
An account may be used only by the account holder.
You may delete your account in the app at any time; what is deleted follows the Privacy Policy and the Account deletion guide.
3. User content
Links, memos, photos, collections and other content you save belong to you, and Juple stores, displays and transmits them only to the extent necessary to provide the service.
You hold the rights to, and are responsible for, the content you save and share. Juple does not guarantee the external content that links point to.
4. Sharing and collaboration

The owner of a collection decides invitations, approval of participation, the public link, the password and participant permissions (read-only / add after approval / add links). Anyone who knows the public link can see the content within the published scope.
The owner may remove participants or stop sharing. If the owner deletes their account, the collection is deleted and participants can no longer access it.
Content you add to another person’s collection may be managed by that collection’s owner.
5. Prohibited conduct
You must not engage in the following conduct:
Saving or sharing illegal content
Infringing the rights of others (intellectual property rights such as copyright, personal information, likeness and the like)
Harassing, threatening, or engaging in hateful or abusive behavior toward other users
Saving or sharing content involving sexual exploitation, illegal sexual content, or inappropriate content targeting children or adolescents
Spam, fraud, or impersonating another person or organization
Sharing malicious links or malware
Any other conduct that violates applicable laws or policies
Unauthorized access to the service or accounts, circumventing security measures, excessive requests, or automated mass use
5-1. Reporting and blocking

If you find a problem with another user, collection, link or comment, you can report it using the report function in the app or on the web. You can choose a reason for the report and add an explanation.

You can block other users. Blocking restricts some interactions between you, such as friend requests, collaboration invitations, and comments and reactions, and you can unblock at any time under “Blocked users” in settings. Blocking does not delete the other person’s content or remove them from collections you already share.
Reports received are reviewed by Juple staff, and the reporter’s information is not disclosed to the person reported. The outcome of a report may not be communicated individually.
6. Paid membership and free trial

Juple has operated a paid membership since 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026 (Korea Standard Time). The membership is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, purchased through Google Play in the Android app and through the Apple App Store in the iPhone and iPad apps. The membership is not sold on the web.

The free trial is available once per user and lasts exactly 720 hours (30 days). Members who signed up before 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026 can use it from 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026 until 10:00 a.m. on December 27, 2026; members who signed up after that time can use it for 720 hours from the time they signed up.
During the free trial you can use all features without registering a payment method. When the free trial ends, it does not automatically turn into a paid subscription and you are not charged.

If you delete your account and sign up again, the free trial does not start over; you can use only the time remaining from the trial period you originally received. For this purpose, Juple keeps a value derived from your sign-in account identifier and email address that cannot be converted back to the original values, together with the trial period, for 24 months after the trial ends (see the Privacy Policy).
The subscription price, currency and renewal period are shown on the app’s membership screen and on the store’s payment screen before you purchase, and may differ by country and store.
You can purchase a subscription even during the free trial. If you do, you are charged immediately on that day, and the remaining free trial period is not added to the subscription period.

Unless you cancel before the next billing date, the subscription renews automatically for the same period and is charged to the payment method of the store account used for the purchase. If the subscription price changes, you will be notified in advance in accordance with the store’s procedures and applicable laws, and your consent will be obtained where required.

Access applies to your Juple account, so a subscription purchased in one store can be used with the same account on Android, iPhone and iPad, and the web. If you subscribe in both stores at the same time, the periods are not combined and each store charges separately, so you must cancel one of them in that store.

Where operationally necessary, Juple may grant a free membership to some users, who have access for the period stated when it is granted. Having a paid subscription or a free membership does not pause or extend the free trial period.
6-1. Managing, canceling and refunding a subscription

You check, change and cancel your subscription in the store where you purchased it (the subscriptions menu in Google Play or the subscriptions menu of your Apple account). You can go to that store screen from the membership screen in the Juple app.
Canceling a subscription stops only the next renewal; you can keep using the service until the end of the period you have already paid for.

Refunds and withdrawal of purchases follow the refund procedures of the store where you purchased and applicable laws. If a payment is canceled due to a refund, payment cancellation or the like, access under that subscription also ends. If you contact the Juple Customer Center, we will help confirm your purchase and explain the store’s refund procedure, but because the store decides whether to refund, not every refund is guaranteed. This clause does not limit rights, such as the right of withdrawal, that applicable laws guarantee to users.

If a payment fails, for example because a card has expired, you can keep using the service during the grace period set by the store; if the payment problem is not resolved during that time, access ends.
Deleting your account does not automatically cancel a store subscription. Please cancel your subscription in the store where you purchased it before deleting your account.
6-2. When you do not have access

If the free trial has ended and you have no valid paid subscription or free membership, Juple becomes read-only. Your saved data is not deleted. For members who signed up before 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026, this restriction does not apply before 10:00 a.m. on December 27, 2026, when their free trial ends.

Features you can keep using: viewing your saved links and collections and collections shared with you, opening original links, exporting data, deleting your own data such as your links, collections and comments, leaving collections and stopping sharing, managing your account and settings, purchasing and restoring a subscription, the Customer Center, reporting and blocking, and deleting your account

Restricted features: saving new links, editing links, restoring from the trash, creating and editing collections, adding, moving and copying links to collections, favorites, sharing settings and invitations, approving participation requests and changing participant permissions, writing comments and reactions, and friend requests

To write to a shared collection, such as adding a link, both you and the collection’s owner must have access. If the owner does not have access, participants cannot write to that collection either, but they can continue to view it.
If you subscribe again, you can use the restricted features again immediately.
This restriction is not a usage restriction for a violation of these Terms (Article 8).
7. Changes to and suspension of the service
Juple may add, change or discontinue features and will give advance notice of important changes. The service may be temporarily interrupted due to outages or maintenance.
8. Usage restrictions and termination
If you violate these Terms or reported content is confirmed to be a violation, Juple may take the following measures:
Receiving the report and reviewing the content
Restricting access to or deleting the content concerned, or stopping sharing
Restricting some of the user’s features
Restricting or suspending use of the account
Further measures for repeated or serious violations
Juple’s reviews are carried out by people, based on reports and the user’s confirmation. You may delete your account at any time.
9. Liability

The service is provided with a reasonable level of care, but Juple does not guarantee the content of external links or the accuracy or lawfulness of content uploaded by users. These Terms do not limit the rights that applicable laws guarantee to users.
10. Changes to these Terms

When these Terms change, the changes and their effective date are posted on this page and in the app’s notices from 7 days before they take effect. Changes that are unfavorable to users or important are posted from 30 days before they take effect and are also announced separately in the app.

If you do not agree to the changed Terms, you may end your use at any time by deleting your account. After the effective date, Juple asks for consent to the changed Terms in the app and on the web, and if you do not consent, your use of the service may be restricted.
The last updated date is shown at the top of this page, and earlier versions of the Terms remain available to read.
11. Contact
You can send an inquiry from **My Page > Customer Center** in the app and read the reply on the same screen.
You can also contact us by email: jupleinfo@gmail.com
Supplementary provisions
These Terms take effect at 3:00 p.m. on November 27, 2026 (Korea Standard Time).

The paid membership and free trial in Article 6 have operated since 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026, and were announced in the app’s notices on the same day. Bringing these Terms into effect does not shorten any free trial period that has already started, and the free trial of members who signed up before 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026 continues until 10:00 a.m. on December 27, 2026.
The previous Terms (revised October 25, 2026) and the original consent text (October 14, 2026) remain available to read on this page.
Privacy Policy
Explains what information Juple processes, why, how long it is kept, and how it is handled when an account is deleted.

Juple is a service for saving links and organizing and sharing them in collections. This policy explains the information processed in the Juple app and the web pages for shared links, and how it is kept and deleted. We do not track behavior for advertising and do not sell personal information.
1. Information we process
**Account and sign-in**

Sign-up and sign-in use an email address and password and take place through Microsoft Entra External ID. The Juple server links to your account only the identifiers assigned by Microsoft Entra External ID (tenant and user identifiers) and does not store your email address or password on the Juple server. Your email address and password are processed by Microsoft Entra External ID.
Values Juple creates: a random Juple ID. Values you enter: a nickname (optional) and a profile photo (optional). Language and time zone settings.
**Content you save or enter yourself**
The address, title, memo and preview image address of links you save, and photos you upload.
Collection names, icons, colors and photos, collection lock passwords (stored as an irreversible hash), and shared access passwords.
Friends and friend requests, private notes about friends, collection invitations and join requests, comments, likes and emoji reactions.
Customer Center inquiries and replies.
History of recently opened links.
**Service safety (reports, blocks, consent to the Terms)**
Records of consent to the Terms of Service: the version of the Terms agreed to and the time of consent.
Reports: the reporter, the subject of the report (user, collection, link or comment), the reason for the report and any explanation added by the user, the processing status and the outcome.
Block relationships: who blocked whom.

**Checking link information**: When you save a link, we may access the public page at that address to check its title and representative image. Information that cannot be confirmed is not guessed; you are asked to enter it yourself.

**Sharing and collaboration**: When you share a collection, participants can see that collection, the links in it, titles, and the nickname or Juple ID and profile photo of the person who added each link. If you turn on the public link, anyone who knows the link can see the collection’s name and the title, address and automatic preview of its links; memos, uploaded photos and who added a link are not made public. You can set a sharing password.

**Push notifications**: To receive notifications, a device identifier (app installation ID), a push token and your language are registered on the server. Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) is used to send Android push notifications, and Apple Push Notification service (APNs) is used to send iOS push notifications. Notification history is stored in the notification list in the app.

**Subscription payments (Google Play and Apple App Store)**: Payments are processed by the store where you purchased (Google Play or Apple App Store), and Juple does not receive card information. When you use subscription features, we process the purchase token or signed transaction information (stored encrypted), the product, status, expiry date and similar details to verify and restore subscriptions. To prevent the free period from being applied more than once, we store a converted value (hash), made by normalizing the sign-in identifier and the sign-in email address in a fixed way and then transforming them so that they cannot be converted back to the original values, together with the period of use. This record does not store the email address itself. The converted value is made with a secret key kept only by Juple (HMAC), and for each converted value only the start and end time of the period of use and the time the record was created are stored with it.

**Service usage records**: For service usage statistics and service improvement, we record, per account, the dates on which the service was used (in UTC), the platform used (Android, iOS or web), the app build number, and the first and last time of use on that day. These usage records do not store the original IP address, the full User-Agent string, precise location information or unique device identifiers.

**Operational logs and diagnostic information**: For the stability, security and incident response of the service, we may process operational logs and diagnostic information containing request processing results, errors, internal identifiers and the like. Passwords and payment tokens are not recorded in logs.
2. Purposes of use
Providing the service, including saving, organizing, sharing and collaborating on links, and notifications
Security, including account verification and preventing misuse
Service safety: receiving and reviewing reports, responding to policy violations, protecting users, and evidencing consent to the Terms of Service
Verifying and restoring subscriptions and managing the free period
Responding to customer inquiries
Checking service stability and responding to incidents

Compiling service usage statistics and improving the service: compiling service usage statistics such as daily, weekly and monthly user numbers and usage by platform, and improving service quality and features
3. Third parties and processing on our behalf
We use the services of the following companies to provide the service, and each company processes information within the scope of the purposes below.

Microsoft (Microsoft Entra External ID): sign-up, sign-in and identity verification. Processes the email address and password used to sign in and the sign-in identifier. When you request account deletion, the sign-in account used for Juple is also deleted.
Microsoft (Azure): hosting of servers, databases, file storage and operational logs. Stores and processes the information in section 1 of this policy (Republic of Korea region).
Google (Firebase Cloud Messaging): sending Android push notifications. Processes push tokens and notification content.
Apple (Apple Push Notification service, APNs): sending iOS push notifications. Processes APNs device tokens and notification content.

Google (Google Play): subscription payment, renewal, cancellation and refunds. Payment information is processed by Google Play, and Juple queries Google Play for purchase tokens and subscription status to verify subscriptions.

Apple (App Store): iOS subscription payment, renewal, cancellation and refunds. Payment information is processed by Apple, and Juple verifies signed transaction information and subscription status and queries the App Store server.
Public websites of links you save: accessed when checking titles and images
We do not sell personal information or provide it for advertising purposes.
4. Retention and deletion

We keep the information above while you keep your account, and when you delete links, collections, photos or comments yourself, that information is deleted. Some information is kept for the periods below and then deleted automatically.
Deleted links (Recently Deleted): up to 30 days after deletion, up to 100 per user
Deleted collections and records for undoing merges: 30 days after deletion
In-app notification history: 90 days after creation
Device tokens for push notifications: 180 days after last use
Records of processing payment notifications: 90 days after processing
Operational logs: up to 30 days
Service usage records (separate from operational logs): kept while the member account is kept and deleted together with the account

Subscription purchase records: the encrypted purchase value is deleted 180 days after the subscription ends, and minimal information such as the purchase identification hash, status and dates is deleted within at most 5 years after the subscription ends.

Hashes and periods of use for preventing repeated free periods: 24 months after the period of use ends (records of a period still in progress are not deleted). Expired records are deleted from the database by a cleanup job that runs daily.
Block relationships: until the block is lifted or the account of either party is deleted
Records of consent to the Terms of Service: while the account is kept (deleted together with the account)
Report records: may be kept even after a report has been processed, to the extent necessary for service safety and responding to policy violations.
5. Handling when an account is deleted

You can delete your account yourself in the app (see the Account deletion guide page). When you delete your account, your profile, links, collections, photos, friends, notifications, inquiries, comments and so on are deleted, and the service usage records linked to that account are deleted as well. The following information may remain, separated from the account, for the retention periods above.
Subscription purchase records (separated from the profile): minimal information for verifying and restoring payments and preventing token reuse
Hashes and periods of use for preventing repeated free periods
Report records: the identifiers of the reporter and the reported person are removed when an account is deleted, and the records may remain without being linked to an account
Operational logs (up to 30 days)

When you request account deletion, the deletion of the Microsoft Entra External ID sign-in account used for the Juple service (sign-in information such as the email address) is also carried out. Once deletion is complete, you can no longer sign in with that email address and password, but you can sign up again with the same email address.
Deleting your account does not automatically cancel a Google Play or Apple App Store subscription. Please cancel the subscription in the store where you purchased it first.
6. Your rights

You can check, correct and delete your information directly in the app by editing your profile, deleting content, deleting your account and so on, and you can make other requests for access, correction, deletion or suspension of processing through the contact methods below.
7. Children under 14
Only people aged 14 or older may sign up for and use Juple. Children under 14 may not create an account or use the service.

In apps and on the web that support age confirmation, you confirm that you are 14 or older yourself while agreeing to the Terms of Service. The age of an existing account is not considered confirmed by its earlier consent to the Terms alone, and age confirmation is requested in stages as supported versions are rolled out. No date of birth or identity document is collected for this age confirmation.

If we become aware that personal information of a user under 14 has been collected, we restrict use and take necessary measures, such as deletion, in accordance with applicable laws. Please send related inquiries and deletion requests to the privacy contact in this policy.
8. Security
Data in transit is encrypted, lock and sharing passwords are stored as hashes, and purchase tokens are stored encrypted. The server checks data ownership on every request.
9. Privacy officer
Inquiries about the processing of personal information, complaints and requests for remedies can be made to the privacy officer below.
Name: 손민욱 (Representative)
Contact: jupleinfo@gmail.com
10. Changes to this policy
When this policy changes, it is posted on this page, and important changes are also announced in the app. The last updated date is shown at the top of this page.
11. Contact
You can send an inquiry from **My Page > Customer Center** in the app and read the reply on the same screen.
You can also contact us by email: jupleinfo@gmail.com
Account deletion guide
Explains how to delete a Juple account, what data is deleted, and what information remains for a certain period after deletion.
This page can be viewed without signing in. Deleting an account cannot be undone.
Deleting your account in the app
Open **My Page** in the Juple app.
Tap **Manage account** and choose **Delete account**.
Check the list of data that will be deleted and tap **Continue deleting account**.
**Sign in again** to confirm your identity.
**Enter the Juple ID exactly as shown** and tap **Permanently delete account**.
Once deletion starts, it cannot be undone.
If you cannot use the app (requesting deletion of the entire account by email)

If you have deleted the app, lost your device or cannot sign in, you can request **deletion of your entire account** by email. If you want to keep your account and delete only some data, see “Deleting data while keeping your account” below.
**Email for deletion requests: jupleinfo@gmail.com**
Write “Juple account deletion request” in the subject line and include the following in the body.
The email address you used to sign up and sign in
Your Juple ID, if you know it
A statement that you want your account and all your saved data deleted

We may ask for additional information to confirm your identity, and confirmed requests are processed to the same extent as deletion in the app. For information that remains after deletion, see “Information that remains after deletion” below.
If you can sign in to the app, deleting your account yourself through “Deleting your account in the app” above is the fastest way.
Deleting data while keeping your account
You can also keep your account and delete only some data. **In this case your account and the rest of your data are kept.** This is a different request from deleting your entire account.
**Deleting directly in the app**
Saved links: deleted links move to Recently Deleted, where you can delete them permanently or empty the list.

Collections and the links in them, uploaded photos, your comments and reactions, friends and friend notes, notifications, and the history of recently opened links: you can delete them directly on each screen.
**Request by email for data you cannot delete in the app or when you cannot use the app**
Email for data deletion requests: jupleinfo@gmail.com
Example subject line: “Juple data deletion request”
Please include the following in the body.
The email address you used to sign up
Your Juple ID, if you know it
The scope of the data you want deleted (for example, a specific collection, uploaded photos, or inquiry history)

We may ask for additional information to confirm your identity. Only the data within the requested scope is deleted, and your account is kept. To delete your account as well, please use the procedure for deleting your entire account above.
Data that is deleted
When you delete your account, the following is permanently deleted.
Your profile (nickname, profile photo, Juple ID) and language and time zone settings
Your saved links and memos, links in Recently Deleted, and uploaded photos
All collections you created and their settings (icon, color, photo, lock password, sharing link). The sharing link no longer opens, and participants can no longer see the collection.
Links you added to other people’s collections, approval and join requests you sent, favorites, and notification settings
Friends, friend requests, and private notes you left about friends
Notification history, device registrations for push notifications, and the history of recently opened links

The sign-in account used for the Juple service (email address and password sign-in information in Microsoft Entra External ID): its deletion is carried out together with the account deletion, after which you can no longer sign in with that email address and password. You can still sign up again with the same email address.
Customer Center inquiries and replies
Your comments, likes and emoji reactions. If someone has replied to your comment, your comment remains as a placeholder without author information so that the conversation is not broken.
Uploaded photo files are deleted from storage by a separate cleanup job after the account information is deleted, which usually happens right away.
Information that remains after deletion

Subscription purchase records (separated from the profile): deleting your account does not automatically cancel a Google Play or Apple App Store subscription. Minimal information (a purchase identification hash, status, dates and the encrypted purchase value) remains, separated from the account, to verify and restore payments and to prevent purchase tokens from being reused. The encrypted purchase value is deleted 180 days after the subscription ends, and the other minimal information within at most 5 years after the subscription ends.

Records for preventing repeated free periods: so that the free period cannot be repeated by signing up again with the same email address, only a converted value (hash) of the sign-in information that cannot be converted back to the original values, and the period of use, remain. The email address itself and names do not remain. They are kept for up to 24 months after the period of use ends.
Operational logs: deleted after being kept for up to 30 days. Logs may contain internal identifiers but do not contain passwords or payment tokens.
If you have a subscription

Even after you delete your account, your subscription may continue to be charged. Cancel your Juple subscription in **Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions** for Google Play purchases, or in **Apple Account settings > Subscriptions** for Apple App Store purchases. Deleting the app or your account alone does not cancel the subscription.
Contact
You can send an inquiry from **My Page > Customer Center** in the app and read the reply on the same screen.
You can also contact us by email: jupleinfo@gmail.com
